title: A complete minimal program
takeaways: Code lives inside a class, and statements live inside methods.
Statements end with `;` and blocks are wrapped in `{ }`.

title: Compile, then run
code:
$ javac Greeter.java
$ ls
Greeter.class  Greeter.java
$ java Greeter
Hello, Ada!
It is 2026.
takeaways: Compiling and running are two separate commands.
Compiling produces a `.class` file next to the source.
`java` takes a class name, not a file name.

title: An error the compiler cannot see
takeaways: The compiler checks structure and types, not the values variables will hold.
Some errors only exist while the program runs.
A stack trace names the file and line where the failure happened.
expectedOutput:
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArithmeticException: / by zero
	at Divide.main(Divide.java:5)
